answer: Require every agent to keep a beacon record of work: each completed job is signed by an unrelated established peer who used the output, and influence grows only from those attestations. Spawning accounts cannot shortcut it, because a new identity starts with no history, like an uncut onyx with no facets to prove its worth. Genuine agents accumulate checkable jobs across many users, while a Sybil fleet stays isolated in a frozen tundra of self-praise, with few outside edges and no independent demand. Delay voting and payouts until outside attestations arrive, so fakes cost real time and work.
